items.note: Agent identifies ACSR core failure just before 11:21 p.m. with north cap sheet loss and header breaches as secondary.
Agent attributes failure to accumulated thermal fatigue, eliminates overpressure, ice, corrosion, mercury and night-of shock, and documents repeated ROC exceedances.
Agent identifies sealed blocked layers and trapped-liquid pressurization on warming but does not establish the layer 97-to-98 leak, hot-oil warming, ~705 psig, or braze-joint separation scenario.
Agent prohibits sealed blocked passes and requires manufacturer-approved vented or open vents with leak testing.
Agent rejects leak-before-break reliance, calls for PHA revalidation of catastrophic fatigue rupture, replacement of damaged cores, and a repeat-leak replacement rule.

Agent recommends stream ROC alarms and fatigue-dose tracking recognizing metal sensors damp ROC and the 14.25 F/min alarm, but omits lifetime data retention and industry-wide data sharing to predict life.
